records.canonicalQuestion: Why does git push reject validate-code.yml on CapitalGlass-Office-Admin?
alternateQuestions: What gh auth scopes are required to push GitHub Actions workflow files?
How to publish workflow fixes when workflow scope is missing?
records.shortAnswer: Git push rejecting .github/workflows changes without workflow scope; use MCP push_files or refresh gh auth before workflow edits.
records.detailedAnswer: Office Admin CI missions require gh workflow OAuth scope
evidenceUrls: gh auth status scopes gist read:org repo

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Any Office Admin mission touching .github/workflows or CI auto-trigger repair
doNot: Assume git push will register workflow triggers after MCP-only workflow commits
Retry identical git push without workflow scope
proveBeforeClaiming: gh auth status lists workflow scope
Push of workflow file succeeds or MCP push_files receipt SHA recorded

records.canonicalQuestion: How to reconcile a conflicting PR when git push blocks workflow files?
alternateQuestions: Why does squash reconciliation leave PR CONFLICTING?
What is the dual-lane workflow publish pattern for Office Admin?
records.shortAnswer: Merge main semantically, push body without workflow delta, then MCP-publish workflow file; record merge parent for GitHub mergeability.
records.detailedAnswer: Reconcile conflicted PR when workflow OAuth scope is missing

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: PR mergeable CONFLICTING with workflow file changes needed and gh lacks workflow scope
runPreflight: npm run deploy:gate with CI smoke actor env
doNot: Merge PR when mission says keep unmerged
Skip merge parent commit — GitHub needs two-parent merge for CLEAN state
proveBeforeClaiming: gh pr view shows mergeable MERGEABLE

records.canonicalQuestion: Why is validate-code stuck queued on CapitalGlass-Office-Admin?
alternateQuestions: What does 'job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted' mean?
How to prove validate-code failure is infrastructure not deploy:gate?
records.shortAnswer: GitHub Actions jobs on windows-latest can queue 15m+ then fail with hosted runner acquisition error; distinguish from code gate failure.
records.detailedAnswer: validate-code queued forever — windows-latest runner not acquired

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: validate-code or validate-docs workflow_dispatch queued >5 minutes
runPreflight: npm run deploy:gate locally with CI smoke env first
doNot: Claim GO from local deploy:gate alone when mission requires GitHub PASS
Cancel and re-dispatch endlessly without checking runner pool/billing
proveBeforeClaiming: gh run shows conclusion success on final HEAD SHA
Job runner_name populated (not empty while queued 15m+)
